 OPPO captures life’s unplanned moments in new Find X10 campaign
 The film follows everyday moments, from a girl giving her father a toy injection and a granddaughter pushing her grandfather on a swing to a boy with his new puppy.
 afaqs! news bureau 
 22 Oct 2026 
 16:33
 IST Follow Us
 New Update OPPO India has launched ‘True to the Moment’, a campaign for its Find X10 Series. The film focuses on everyday experiences, including family interactions, celebrations and more personal moments.
 The film features multiple characters rather than a single protagonist. It includes a girl pretending to give her father an injection with a toy, a granddaughter pushing her grandfather on a swing, a boy holding his new puppy and a family celebrating a grandmother’s 65th birthday.
 The film also shows quieter moments, including a teenager looking at himself in the mirror, a girl eating ice cream while holding back tears and a man wiping away tears alone. The scenes move across homes, parks, cafés and beaches, connected through movement, sound and emotion.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by OPPO India (@oppoindia) 
 The campaign also highlights the camera capabilities of the Find X10 Series, which features a Triple 200 MP camera system and 4K Cine-Grade HDR Video. The film focuses on unposed moments, including those captured in low light and while in motion.
 OPPO India has rolled out the film across its digital platforms and select OTT channels.
 Commenting on the occasion, Dhruv Nigam, head of Product Marketing, OPPO India, said: “The memories we hold on to are rarely the ones we planned for. They are the unguarded laughs, the quiet glances and the little things that mean the world to the those living them. ‘True to the Moment’ celebrates the simplicity of such instances.
 Over ten generations, the Find X Series has pushed the limits of what a flagship can do, but with the Find X10 Series, we have also looked at that progress through the eyes of the user: not just what technology can do, but what it means to the person using it. With industry-leading camera and performance, supported by ColorOS 17, it is built to stay true to life exactly as it was felt, so that looking back takes you right back to it.”
 The Find X10 Series comprises the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max, marking the 10th generation of OPPO’s Find X lineup. The series combines an imaging system co-developed with Hasselblad and OPPO’s LUMO True Image Engine, along with enhancements to the design, display and battery.
 The series also introduces ColorOS 17 and upgraded hardware intended to support everyday use and more demanding creative work. The India launch event is scheduled to stream on OPPO India’s YouTube channel from 4:30 PM IST on October 22.
